judgment.notes: N011 applies to each truncation with the unchanged smooth-ball constants. N001 applies to the original datum and each truncation; their L2 norms are at most R, so the stated 2R continuous-dependence condition holds. N007 applies at the positive fixed timestep on the real mean-zero L2 space. The routine facts in BG001-BG003 have their actual premises available. There are no local external E applications.

S001 extracts precisely the grid-error clause of N011. S002 supplies smooth approximants in the same radius-R ball. S003 obtains uniform-in-time exact-flow convergence and, at fixed tau and finite Lsteps, convergence of each numerical iterate. S004 passes the error inequality to each grid point by norm continuity and then takes a finite maximum. No tau-uniform continuity of Psi or exchange of a timestep limit is used. Existence, the stipulated solution meaning, the unfiltered rough recursion and uniformity of both positive constants all follow as asserted.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
